title: SDEval: Safety Dynamic Evaluation for Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on the 'Bias' dimension of the MLLMGuard and VLSBench safety benchmarks by applying dynamic multimodal perturbations (such as text paraphrasing, word replacement, image augmentation, and cross-modal jailbreaking) to prompts involving sensitive attributes like religion, nationality, and profession, then scoring the safety of the outputs using an LLM-based judge (Attack Success Degree and Perfect Answer Rate).
